The wheels are standard bicycle size (26-28 inches). The overall silhouette is a stretched bicycle profile with two distinct rider positions.

Body is medium-sized, well-proportioned, and muscular. Head is round with a short muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, pointed, and erect. Eyes are large, round, and green, gold, or copper. The breed's signature features include the distinctive tabby pattern with M forehead marking and striped legs.
